records.text: Turning Point USA donors who attended AmericaFest say Charlie Kirk never made the recorded statement appointing Erika Kirk as CEO.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #3 (Ep 69A8TzAGHlU)

appearances.snippet: Donors literally telling me that she is lying about the audio clip that she presented at AmFest. The one that they now assert that they are never going to show us the video component regarding Charlie Kirk saying Erika Kirk, I appoint my wife, Erika (Erika Kirk), to become the CEO. ... Donors saying that actually never went down. He never said that.

verification.notes: This relies on unnamed donors recounting a private or semi-private event and disputing an audio clip. Searches found public video and later controversy but no identifiable donor testimony or authenticated evidence establishing what those donors heard and whether the appointment statement occurred.
